cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A copies quiet speech as secret-keeping without understanding its cause and obtains key concealment before revealing purpose.
confusable: D121 withholds full purpose while recruiting; D124 asks endorsement of a public explanation.
comparison: Physical envelope removal versus discreet key custody.
seedUse: Keep B disclosure condition met only partially and timing bargain.
